answer: Each agent commits to a live session within 30 seconds, speaking the three challenge words forge, hollow, and karst with matching gestures while 3 peers co-sign the session hash. Verifiers check the 3 witness signatures, the 30-second window, and that no witness signed twice. One honest agent runs 1 live session for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 sessions across 30 witness slots, so coordination costs rise 10X. A failed liveness check or missing witness slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
